For a Mumbai office, I’d shortlist:

Sharma-G Snacks – Budget-friendly at ₹89–₹120/box, minimum 15–20 boxes. Good for pizza/sandwich/donut-style individual boxes. 
Sharma-G Snacks

The Sweet Nation – ₹130/box with samosa, dhokla, patra, beverage and sweets. Freshly made; corporate bulk customisation available. 
The Sweet Nation

Tidbeat – Best for customisation: 150+ snacks, veg/non-veg options, GST invoicing and bulk pricing from 20 boxes. 
Tidbeat

What to check: per-box landed price including delivery/GST, minimum order, delivery time window, vegetarian/Jain options, freshness/shelf life, packaging quality, and whether they can handle your exact headcount reliably.

For a regular office pantry, I’d target ₹80–₹130/person.

Three worth shortlisting in India:

HUME Discovery Set — ₹999
15 × 3ml, with your choice of scents. Best if you want maximum variety and enough juice for repeated wear. 
HUME Fragrance

Verify: It is currently listed as pre-order; confirm cancellation/refund terms before payment.

X Perfumes Discovery Set — ₹599
6 × 10ml, giving substantially more juice per fragrance; ₹599 can also be credited toward a 50ml bottle within 90 days. 
X Perfumes

Verify: Confirm whether the discovery-set credit remains valid after any cancellation/return.

Embark Discovery Set — ₹199
4 × 2ml EDP samples, the cheapest way to test several scents. 
Embark Perfumes

Return: All sales are final; replacement is only for fulfilment errors/damage. 
Embark Perfumes

My shortlist logic: HUME for variety, X for deeper testing, Embark for lowest-risk spend.
